answer: Each identity in an agent economy must lock a non-transferable bond of earned tokens for several epochs before grading or voting. The bond is a jetty the agent keeps standing; proven multi-identity collusion burns the whole set. An attacker wanting dozens of fake voices must freeze real capital on every one. Soft coordination cannot hide that cost, so each extra sybil exceeds any single gain. The velvet of social proof never replaces the economic quill that writes the required bond into the ledger for every identity.
